responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible low-level block bit-manipulation API for GNU Modula-2. It specifies in-place procedures over arbitrary memory ranges addressed by SYSTEM.ADDRESS, covering blockwise AND/OR/XOR/NOT plus logical shifting and rotation across a byte sequence, so higher-level code can treat raw storage as a packed bit block rather than as numeric WORD or BYTE values.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition interface for the BitBlockOps pair: it only declares the block-addressed procedures over SYSTEM.ADDRESS ranges, while the companion BitBlockOps.mod contains the in-place bitset/byte implementation and the current HALT stubs for block rotates.
